items.prompt:
From the following JSON array of image filenames and descriptions, extract a 1 dimensional array of the image descriptions and store it in output field. Prepend each of the image descriptions with the image style ({imagestyle}): data1

{imagedescriptions}

Also copy over the following content as is, into output field: fictionyarn

{fictionstory}

# Output Instructions
Your output consists of two top-level keys and their values:
data1 — a 1-dimensional array of individual image descriptions
fictionyarn - a string containing an interactive fiction story in Yarn format.

lessonDescription: This template accepts a fiction item story, and image prompts, and generates pictures for the story from the supplied image prompts. This template takes as input:  story summary, an image generation style, a story in yarn format with image placeholders, and a json array with image filenames + image generation prompts. It produces 2 items, a content page item with a picture, and a fiction item with images matching all the placeholders.

user_topic.title: Story Summary
user_topic.description: A summary of the story that will be used for image generation

user_text.title: Fiction Story
user_text.description:
An interactive fiction story written in Yarn format. Do not write it from memory: first call mod_minilesson_aigen_fetch_item_type_details with itemtype "fiction" and follow the authoringguide it returns, which covers the yarn syntax this player supports and how to structure a story worth reading.

In each chapter add a picture command as the next line after the '---' divider.   The picture command should take the following format <<picture XX.png>>
The filenames of the pictures should be 2-digit numerical, e.g 01.png
